## PulteGroup Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend of $0.26 Per Share


09/02/2026


Download (opens in new window)


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


PulteGroup, Inc. (NYSE: PHM) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.26 per common share payable October 2, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 15, 2026.


**About PulteGroup**


PulteGroup, Inc. (NYSE: PHM), based in Atlanta, Georgia, is one of America’s largest homebuilding companies with operations in more than 45 markets throughout the country. Through its brand portfolio that includes Pulte Homes, Centex, Del Webb, DiVosta Homes, and John Wieland Homes and Neighborhoods, the company is one of the industry’s most versatile homebuilders able to meet the needs of multiple buyer groups and respond to changing consumer demand. PulteGroup’s purpose is building incredible places where people can live their dreams.


For more information about PulteGroup, Inc. and PulteGroup brands, go to[pultegroup.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpultegroup.com%2F&esheet=54597975&newsitemid=20260902907056&lan=en-US&anchor=pultegroup.com&index=1&md5=0186730c7f63328cc29ed2ce1fe4fd5e) ;[pulte.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fpulte.com&esheet=54597975&newsitemid=20260902907056&lan=en-US&anchor=pulte.com&index=2&md5=b274c453ae043ecf6cdf5add7ebe1005) ;[centex.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fcentex.com&esheet=54597975&newsitemid=20260902907056&lan=en-US&anchor=centex.com&index=3&md5=aa2bbbf7fd29b9cd6af2ed35d0cf8312) ;[delwebb.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fdelwebb.com&esheet=54597975&newsitemid=20260902907056&lan=en-US&anchor=delwebb.com&index=4&md5=bf4145c3c75e11f57136179a6b0bfc3c) ;[divosta.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fdivosta.com&esheet=54597975&newsitemid=20260902907056&lan=en-US&anchor=divosta.com&index=5&md5=493f4a60cab56cb06e01bf24a98f5eec) ; and[jwhomes.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fjwhomes.com&esheet=54597975&newsitemid=20260902907056&lan=en-US&anchor=jwhomes.com&index=6&md5=c55eccea9b4d26598d7b7ccbac2016bb) .
